title: Imported chats must be browseable and searchable
observed_problem: 74 chats / 10034 messages imported but no archive browsing/search was available
root_cause: Import and active-session chat flows were separated in the reported diagnostic
approach_that_failed: Treating import count as full acceptance
effective_approach: Verify list/open/search/manage and deduplication against imported records
exceptions: Exact implementation cause requires current code verification
prevention_rule: Import acceptance includes visible archive and retrieval

title: Preserve RAW source and link interpretations with provenance
trigger: Extracting memory objects from imported chat/file sources
observed_problem: Architecture requires source traceability and separation from derived objects
effective_approach: Keep immutable RAW and attach provenance/version/confidence/links to derived memory
exceptions: Implementation must be verified in current schema/runtime
prevention_rule: Never silently replace RAW with normalized interpretation

title: Keep download and OAuth failures as separate incidents
trigger: Several WebView problems occur in the same release
observed_problem: Zero-byte downloads and ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED after login were separate paths
approach_that_failed: Assuming one fix resolved both flows
effective_approach: Maintain separate logs and acceptance tests for download, attachment and OAuth navigation
exceptions: Only merge incidents if evidence establishes a shared cause
prevention_rule: Track independent paths and verify each one after changes

title: Protect memory integrity with reversible deletion and link checks
trigger: Memory capacity cleanup, compaction, deletion or pruning
observed_problem: Potentially important memory and its links could be lost if cleanup automatically deletes data to make space
root_cause: Not an implementation incident; this is a user-stated architecture requirement
approach_that_failed: Automatic irreversible deletion based only on capacity pressure
effective_approach: Safe cleanup, reversible quarantine, connectivity/reference validation and recoverability before irreversible deletion
exceptions: Exact safeguards and implementation remain to be tested
prevention_rule: Do not sacrifice potentially significant memory automatically; use reversible stages and validate links before final deletion
